name: chat-queue
description: The session's turn queue (ADR 0197): the person's waiting messages as ghost bubbles to edit (which holds the turn), withdraw or send now, and one quiet line for what another agent, a workflow or Work queued (ADR 0217). Keyed by turn id; feed it useAgentChat().queue. chat-timeline renders it under the conversation.
docs: Wire onEdit, onCancel, onSendNow and onHold to useAgentChat's editQueued, cancelQueued, sendQueuedNow and holdQueued; each control shows only when its callback is given, and a callback resolving false keeps the control actionable with an error. renderContent and renderAttachments draw a message's words and its attachments (chat-timeline passes its pills), renderInput draws the line for a turn that is not the person's own words, and Hint ({ label, shortcut?, children }) names the controls on hover (default: the native title). An edit holds the turn until it is saved or abandoned, and the draft is the words without attachment markers: the attachments stay with the message.
